definition.required_evidence: Exact MethodRequirementRefs for published required requirements declaring evidence_kinds, qualified to the same BoundProcedure/MethodPlan. Backend copies published required, cannot demote via child.
definition.minimum: Count exact verified output proofs after receipt/schema validation. Shortfall always retains coverage gap; mandatory=true blocks COMPLETE/SUCCEEDED; mandatory=false retains gap without blocking otherwise-required completion.
definition.optional: All rows remain explicit. Required missing map stays INCOMPLETE/INCONCLUSIVE; return alone is not success.
